index_quote1: At Hearten Home Interiors, we design with purpose—thoughtful spaces in DFW that work beautifully, live well, and last.
index_eyebrow1: Interior Design & Renovation — Dallas / Fort Worth
index_text1: Designed for the life you really live. Creating spaces where great memories happen.
index_text2: For thirty years, Bonnie Roden was the friend everyone called — the one who could walk into a home and see what it was trying to become.
index_text3: In 2024, she finally put her name on a door. Hearten Home Interiors is the business she spent three decades building without knowing it — and her goal is as simple as it is rare: to make you feel better about your home…and to truly love it. For you to have an atmosphere that refreshes and inspires you…not just because it's beautiful, but because it's a reflection of you.
index_text4: From full-scale renovations to intentional room styling and holiday readiness, Bonnie guides the creative direction from the very first mood board to the final walk-through.
index_text5: Every detail is handled — the contractors, the timelines, the decisions — so you can simply step into your new space and enjoy.
